headline: On October 23, 2007: Space Shuttle Discovery launches on STS-120
captionCards: Pamela Melroy: 2nd female space shuttle commander
instagramCaption:
Pamela Melroy leads a historic mission. \\[Pamela Melroy became the second female space shuttle commander on this launch. The Space Shuttle Discovery, one of NASA's most reliable orbiters, embarked on its 34th mission, STS-120. Over 27 years, Discovery completed 39 missions, more than any other spacecraft by December 2024. This mission highlighted the growing role of women in space exploration. \\Why do you think it's important to have diverse representation in space missions? \\Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
